general.evidence_quote: 911 serves as the unified national emergency dispatch center

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Panama genelinde seyahat güvenlidir; Darien bölgesi ve Kolombiya sınır ormanlarından kesinlikle uzak durulmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Panama City and tourist hubs are safe; avoid the Darién region due to extreme wilderness crime.
advisory_headline.de: Panama-Stadt und Tourismusgebiete sind sicher; die Darién-Dschungelregion unbedingt meiden.
advisory_headline.ru: Панама-Сити и туристические зоны безопасны; строго избегайте региона Дарьен на границе с Колумбией.
advisory_headline.es: Ciudad de Panamá y centros turísticos son seguros; evite estrictamente la región del Darién.

regional_warnings.reason: Presence of armed smuggling groups and impassable jungle; completely unsafe for travelers.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Panama reach approximately 36.8 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Panama measure 152.4 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: US Dollar bills are the everyday currency; no money exchange needed. Tigo and +Móvil offer 4G/5G prepaid tourist eSIMs with extensive canal corridor and island coverage.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid mobile eSIMs provide immediate high-speed data activation for foreign visitors

tr.conditions: Türkiye Cumhuriyeti umuma mahsus, hususi ve hizmet pasaportu hamilleri 90 güne kadar vizeden muaftır.

us.conditions: US citizens can enter Panama visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days with return ticket and proof of solvency ($500).

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not need a visa for tourist visits to Panama of up to 90 days.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can enter Panama visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Панаму без визы на срок до 90 дней с туристическими целями.

dos.title: Use US Dollars directly
dos.description: Panama uses the US Dollar as official currency; bring clean US dollar bills and credit/debit cards.

dos.title: Visit Miraflores Visitor Center early
dos.description: Vessel transit times at the Panama Canal locks peak in the morning and late afternoon; book tickets online in advance.

dos.title: Carry proof of financial solvency
dos.description: Panama immigration law allows border agents to request proof of minimum $500 USD in cash or credit card limit.

donts.title: Never attempt travel to Darien jungle
donts.description: The Darien border region is an active human trafficking and smuggling zone with no emergency infrastructure.

donts.title: Don't hail unofficial street cabs at night
donts.description: Use verified ride-hailing apps like Uber or licensed radio taxis rather than unmetered yellow street cabs.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Panama City.
